concept: A quiet breathing and wellbeing pause
brief: A serene wellbeing-practice symbol: one elegantly simplified adult human figure seated cross-legged in a calm upright breathing posture, head a small pale-sage sphere, shoulders/arms and legs formed by broad eucalyptus-teal ceramic curves. Hands rest openly on the knees, no ritual mudras. One airy pale-sage OPEN ARC behind the shoulders suggests a slow expanding breath and generous personal space. Clear human breathing/relaxation practice, not a heart-care badge, face mask, medical icon or abstract loop. Teal #4A7480, sage #AEC7BB and off-white #F0F4F1. No face details, clothing texture, religious symbols, lotus petals, clinical cross, ECG, brain anatomy or text. Compact dignified silhouette, not a toy mascot.
prompt: Create one original premium mobile-app BRAND SYMBOL on a fully transparent RGBA square. No wordmark, text, letters or numerals. Restrained dimensional ceramic/fine-metal depth, premium soft studio illumination, confident few-part geometry, broad shapes legible at48px. Center artwork with longest extent around72% of canvas, entirely transparent margins. No background tile, ground shadow, decorative debris or microscopic detail.
